name: Yang Chü-yüan
bio: Yang Chü-yüan is dated by Giles to the 8th and 9th centuries AD. His poem here is on a poet’s taste in landscape.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: Taste
poems.author: Yang Chü-yüan
poems.text:
The landscape which the poet loves is that of early May,
When budding greenness half concealed enwraps each willow spray.
That beautiful embroidery the days of summer yield,
Appeals to every bumpkin who may take his walks afield.
